model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of different functional categories within a linguistic dataset. The chart contains six slices, each representing a distinct category: Negation, Universal Quantifiers, Comparative Relationships, Approximate Quantities, Disjunctive &Conjunctive, and Categorical. The slices are colored in shades of pink, light blue, blue-green, light yellow, purple, and light pink, respectively. The proportions shown are as follows: Negation is 27.91%, Universal Quantifiers is 29.07%, Comparative Relationships is 36.26%, Approximate Quantities is 45.03%, Disjunctive &Conjunctive is 49.51%, and Categorical is 18.71%. Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice, and a legend identifying each category and its corresponding color is present. The segments are visually organized in a clockwise direction from Negation, and appear roughly ordered by size from largest to smallest.
